title: Abstract maximal hypoellipticity and applications
summary: We prove an abstract theorem of maximal hypoellipticy showing that in an abstract calculus under some natural assumptions, an operator is maximally hypoelliptic if and only if its principal symbol is left invertible. We then show that our theorem implies various known results in the literature like regularity theorem for elliptic operators, Helffer and Nourrigat's resolution of the Rockland conjecture, Rodino's theorem on regularity of operators on products of manifolds, and our resolution of the Helffer-Nourrigat conjecture.
